name: Cardedeu (Spain)
description: Yellow field with four red horizontal stripes and a light blue triangle with its base along the hoist and its apex at the centre, charged with a yellow thistle of three flowers.
history: The flag was approved on 16 January 2002 and published in the Diari Oficial de la Generalitat de Catalunya no. 3568 of 5 February 2002; it is an oblong flag of 2:3, yellow with four red stripes and a light blue triangle with its base along the hoist and its apex at the centre of the cloth, charged with a yellow thistle of three flowers.

features.role: triangle from the hoist edge to the centre
thistle of three flowers, 5/18 of the height
